capabilities.label: Semantic animation action and pose-spec contracts
capabilities.purpose: Validate action phases, identity invariants, root/prop continuity, gameplay event markers and review state before any engine integration, and reject static-image pulse/transform gimmicks as character animation.
dependencies: jsonschema optional extra for full schema validation
limitations: Structural validation cannot judge silhouette, weight, arcs, contact or readability; playback and in-engine review remain required.

capabilities.label: Animation frame audit and assembly
capabilities.purpose: Normalize frame canvas/anchors and create preview GIF, spritesheet, manifest, and measurable diagnostic signals.
dependencies: Pillow and NumPy optional vision extras
limitations: Diagnostics cannot judge semantic motion, weight, timing, or expressive readability; playback inspection is required.

capabilities.label: Deterministic sprite atlas packing
capabilities.purpose: Pack images into an atlas with metadata and padding suitable for downstream engine integration.
limitations: Target-engine import and edge-bleed checks remain project-specific.

capabilities.label: Blender Action authoring and review renders
capabilities.purpose: Create or inspect transform-keyed Blender Actions from a validated pose spec, render review frames and verify the source .blend stays unchanged.
limitations: Executed on one Windows machine with Blender 5.2 as recorded in docs/studio/LOCAL_CREATIVE_UPGRADE_VERIFICATION_2026-10-20.md; not executed in CI, and rendered frames are review candidates rather than approved animation.

capabilities.label: Blender availability probe
capabilities.purpose: Discover a local Blender executable and read its version without forcing a Blender install.
limitations: No Blender animation/render was executed in this clean-room validation.

capabilities.label: ComfyUI API workflow execution
capabilities.purpose: Validate API-format workflows, submit jobs, poll history, download outputs, and record output hashes.
dependencies: Compatible local ComfyUI service, nodes and models
limitations: Automated tests use a local protocol fixture. They do not prove a particular real checkpoint/node graph runs on the target GPU.

capabilities.label: Bounded creative-tool MCP server
capabilities.purpose: Expose preflight, animation contract validation and Blender authoring/render tools over stdio with workspace-contained paths, argument bounds and fixed bundled scripts.
dependencies: Local Blender executable for Blender-backed tools
limitations: Automated tests cover path containment, protocol negotiation and process bounding; Blender-backed tools require a local Blender installation and were exercised on one machine, not in CI.

capabilities.label: Read-only creative resource preflight
capabilities.purpose: Discover local creative executables and loopback services, measure RAM/GPU/disk headroom, and emit a conservative generation policy without guessing unknown values.
limitations: Advisory only: a passing preflight does not approve a specific model/workflow or guarantee a generation will fit.

capabilities.label: Godot project validation and guarded export
capabilities.purpose: Check project structure, invoke selected Godot validation/export commands with timeouts, and inspect output existence.
dependencies: Godot 4 executable; export templates and named preset for export
limitations: A command exit code or nonempty export does not prove the game plays correctly. External engine execution was not run in this container.

capabilities.label: Model-specific Klein and Z-Image workflow builders
capabilities.purpose: Build explicit API-format workflow graphs for supported model variants and generation settings.
dependencies: Compatible workflow nodes and exact model assets in local ComfyUI
limitations: Builder validity is not live-generation proof. Model files, node versions, VRAM, licensing and output quality must be checked on the target machine.

capabilities.label: Image inspection and deterministic refinement
capabilities.purpose: Inspect dimensions, alpha, occupancy and hashes; trim, resize, conservative edge-background removal, and create contact sheets.
dependencies: Pillow and NumPy optional vision extras
limitations: Edge-color removal is not semantic matting. Numeric signals are not aesthetic-quality scores.

capabilities.label: Time-boxed production planner
capabilities.interface: ags jam profiles; ags jam plan
capabilities.purpose: Plan 24-hour, 72-hour, and 14-day work within a release reserve while respecting dependencies and reporting cuts.
limitations: A deterministic greedy planner is not a full critical-path or resource-constrained scheduler; estimates require calibration.

capabilities.label: Authenticated local HTTP API
capabilities.purpose: Expose a bearer-authenticated command surface with request-size bounds, structured errors and loopback-first config.
limitations: Designed for a local trusted workflow, not an internet-facing multi-user service.

capabilities.label: MCP JSON-RPC stdio server
capabilities.purpose: Expose discoverable local studio tools over protocol-clean stdio.
limitations: Protocol tests and local smoke tests do not verify every external coding agent's configuration.

capabilities.label: Godot 2D project factory
capabilities.purpose: Create a clearly labeled Godot 4 starter fixture with safe slugging and scoped output paths.
limitations: Starter fixture is not a finished game and still requires actual design, content, and engine validation.

capabilities.label: Public-release audit and source packaging
capabilities.purpose: Inventory and hash release files; exclude secrets, local state, caches and common model-weight formats; refuse unsafe symlinks and accidental overwrite.
limitations: The tool does not certify copyright, commercial model rights, game quality, or human approval.

capabilities.label: Optional RIFE interpolation wrapper
capabilities.purpose: Run a configured RIFE ncnn-vulkan interpolation process and inspect basic output/alpha signals.
dependencies: Optional RIFE binary and compatible model
limitations: Interpolation does not invent semantic motion; output alpha/silhouette and playback must be reviewed. No RIFE invocation occurred in this container.

capabilities.label: JSON Schema contract library
capabilities.purpose: Provide machine-readable project, art, asset, animation, task, license, review, QA, and release contracts.
dependencies: jsonschema optional extra for full validation
limitations: Schema syntax validation does not prove a project's creative or gameplay quality.

capabilities.label: Stable Diffusion WebUI API
capabilities.purpose: Call a compatible local WebUI API and save returned image outputs.
dependencies: Compatible local WebUI with API enabled and a loaded model
limitations: Endpoint behavior and supported fields vary by WebUI distribution/version; local model quality is not inferred.

capabilities.label: Searchable specialist skill library
capabilities.purpose: Load 87 production skills covering design, genres, art styles, assets, animation, rigging, engineering, QA, and release.
limitations: A skill is guidance, not proof that the described tool or outcome has been tested.

capabilities.label: Workspace, configuration and evidence store
capabilities.purpose: Initialize a workspace, inspect local prerequisites, and persist command outcomes and feedback.
limitations: Doctor readiness does not mean optional image models or game engines are installed.
